title: Companion Ticket Verification
scenario: An email says your companion ticket needs re-verification before you can use it.

answers.A: Upload your passport and card details through the email link.
answers.B: Reply and ask the sender to confirm your booking reference.
answers.C: Check the companion ticket inside your airline or card account.
answers.D: Call the number on your card or airline membership page.

explanation: A companion-ticket message can be used to harvest identity documents. Verify the benefit in the account you opened yourself.
proTip: Perks live in your account; they do not need a surprise document upload.
